task_description: Add two interactive, read-only MCP App tools to the existing PayAlly MCP server: `explore-product` (inline Embla carousel of product cards) and `getproductbyid` (inline single-product card). Use the standard MCP Apps extension (@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps: registerAppTool/registerAppResource/RESOURCE_MIME_TYPE + the React hooks useApp/useHostStyles) for cross-client behavior, and @openai/apps-sdk-ui (React 18/19 + Tailwind 4) for the visuals. Build a new web/ pipeline (React + Tailwind 4 + esbuild, Embla bundled locally) that outputs one self-contained JS bundle per widget which the server inlines into each ui:// resource. Widgets are read-only: no cross-tool calls, no action buttons, no follow-up messages; the carousel keeps prev/next arrows + drag-to-scroll. AUTHORITATIVE SCOPE: merchant id comes ONLY from process.env.PAYPAL_MERCHANT_ID (passed as each tool's merchantIdFallback arg; never from authInfo), so the now-unused resolveMerchantId is removed from shared.ts. The existing AuthInfo tool, its getUserProfile import, and all Auth0 middleware in src/index.ts are KEPT exactly as-is — index.ts only gains the two new tool registrations beside AuthInfo. The explore-product tool ALSO accepts two OPTIONAL numeric tool arguments min_price and max_price (z.number().optional()) that are forwarded to the PayAlly explore-products API as the query params min_price/max_price only when provided (omitted when undefined); these are caller-supplied args, not the merchant id.
